subject: Biology
prompt: Which pigment is present in chlorophyll b but absent in chlorophyll a?
explain: Chlorophyll b has an aldehyde (–CHO) group at C-7 instead of the –CH₃ of chlorophyll a.

subject: Biology
prompt: Plastoquinone (PQ) is chemically similar to which molecule?
explain: Plastoquinone resembles ubiquinone (coenzyme Q) structurally; both are lipid-soluble electron carriers.

subject: Biology
prompt: Which scientist gave the concept of photosynthetic unit / quantasome?
explain: Emerson and Arnold (1932) proposed the concept of photosynthetic unit (quantasome) based on flash experiments.

subject: Biology
prompt: Which scientist first isolated and identified photosynthetic pigments by chromatography?
explain: Michael Tswett invented paper chromatography and separated chloroplast pigments. NCERT Ch 13.
